desc.zh: 诸葛亮先后收复越雟、牂牁二郡，所向披靡，军威大振。大军于永昌整军备马，准备挥师东进，直指建宁。孟获凭南中山川之险，严加戒备，誓与蜀军一决高下。山河未静，胜负未分，一场鏖战，已在所难免。
desc.en: Zhuge Liang has recaptured the two commanderies of Yuexi and Zangke in succession, sweeping all before him and greatly bolstering the army's might. The army regroups and readies its horses at Yongchang, preparing to march east directly toward Jianning. Relying on the rugged terrain of Nanzhong, Meng Huo stands on strict guard, vowing to contest with the Shu army. The land is not yet at peace, victory is undecided, and a fierce battle is inevitable.
